heartStructure.titleDOM: Renderer prepends the existing #page-title into .verse-body immediately before #verse; non-heart returns it to scenePanel.
heartStructure.titleAndVerseLayout: Both siblings display:inline-block; vertical-align:top; writing-mode:vertical-rl; direction:ltr. Their shared scroll container uses direction:rtl and white-space:nowrap. Baseline has no wrapper grouping the pair.
heartStructure.baselineHeartFrame: Shared reader-controls.css .reader-framed-heart .scripture keeps prior/common art-height × art-ratio, centered as a frame; .verse-body occupies its full inner width/height with overflow:auto. Centering the frame is separate from centering the actual title+verse group.
heartStructure.scrollSemantics: Horizontal RTL scrolling only if actual columns exceed frame; preserve complete text, strong emphasis, native previous/next and original reading links.
